data.name: Alawi
data.gender_notes: Alawi is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'l-w-y', meaning 'to be high-ranking, exalted, noble'. The name Alawi carries the meaning “Exalted, Noble” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Alawi usually hope their child will grow to embody exalted, noble and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A person of high moral and spiritual standing
data.etymology: Alawi belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Exalted, Noble.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Alawi total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: علوي
in_arabic.meaning: منسوب إلى الإمام علي عليه السلام، دليل على النسب الشريف
in_arabic.long_meaning: العلوي هو اسم مشتق من الإمام علي عليه السلام، ويعبر عن النسب الشريف والمكانة الرفيعة في الإسلام. يستخدم هذا الاسم لتكريم الأسرة النبوية وخاصة أتباع الإمام علي وفاطمة الزهراء. يعتبر الاسم من الأسماء المحببة في الثقافة الإسلامية وخاصة في المجتمعات الشيعية.

in_urdu.name: علوی
in_urdu.meaning: امام علی سے منسلک، شریف النسل، عالی نسب
in_urdu.long_meaning: علوی نام امام علی رضی اللہ عنہ سے منسلک ہے، جو کہ ایک شریف اور عالی نسب کا اشارہ ہے۔ یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں خاص طور پر شیعہ مسلمانوں میں بہت مقبول ہے، کیونکہ یہ علی ابن ابی طالب اور فاطمہ الزہراء کے وارثین کی طرف اشارہ کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: अलवी
in_hindi.meaning: इमाम अली से जुड़ा, शरीफ वंश का, उच्च वंश का
in_hindi.long_meaning: अलवी नाम इमाम अली से जुड़ा हुआ है, जो एक शरीफ और उच्च वंश का संकेत है। यह नाम इस्लामी संस्कृति में, विशेष रूप से शिया मुसलमानों के बीच बहुत लोकप्रिय है, क्योंकि यह अली इब्न अबी तालिब और फातिमा अल-ज़हरा के वारिसों की ओर इशारा करता है।

in_pashto.name: علوي
in_pashto.meaning: د امام علي سره تړلی، شریف نسب، لوړ نسب
in_pashto.long_meaning: علوي نوم د امام علي سره تړلی دی، کوم چې د شریف او لوړ نسب اشاره ده. دا نوم د اسلامي کلتور په ځانګړي ډول د شيعه مسلمانانو په منځ کې ډېر مشهور دی، ځکه چې دا د علي بن ابي طالب او فاطمې الزهرا د وارثينو ته اشاره کوي.

in_english.name: Alawi
in_english.meaning: Associated with Imam Ali, noble lineage, high-born
in_english.long_meaning: The name Alawi is derived from Imam Ali, signifying a noble lineage and high-born status. This name holds significant importance in Islamic culture, particularly among Shia Muslims, as it refers to the descendants of Imam Ali and Fatimah. It symbolizes a connection to the Prophet Muhammad's family and is considered a revered name in Islamic tradition.

pronunciation.pashto: په پښتو کې د تلفظ: علوي (alawi)

data.cultural_impact: The term "Alawi" is a reference to the Alawites, an offshoot of Shia Islam, mainly living in Syria. Their name is a testament to their self-perception as a noble and exalted community. Historically, the Alawites have been perceived as a distinct religious and ethnic group, influencing Syria's complex religious and political landscape. This name has played a crucial role in their history, shaping their unique social identity and traditions.
data.spiritual_significance: The term "Alawi" also signifies a deep spiritual connection to Allah. As Alawites are considered a branch of Shia Islam, they pay particular importance to the Imamate, the spiritual and political leadership of their Imams, who are believed to be the direct descendants of Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him. This spiritual connection guides their religious beliefs and practices, emphasizing faith, devotion, and submission to Allah's will. Meanwhile, living up to the name "Alawi," which translates to 'noble', 'exalted', 'high-ranking', they continually strive to uphold noble values and moral standards.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that The Alawites are an offshoot of Shia Islam, originating in the 1st millennium AD in Syria. The name Alawi carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: The Alawites are believed to have developed from early Shia sects in Syria, and their beliefs and practices have distinct differences from those of other Shia groups.

trends: The term 'Alawi' is used primarily in academic and scholarly contexts, and is less commonly used in everyday language among Muslims.
modern_usage.modern_context: The name Alawi remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.
